name: numbers-currency-prefix-checks-small-integers
description: Integers <= min_integer 10 are skipped unless a currency sign ($ € £) is the code unit just before them. €3 is checked and known (the evidence has €3). $5 is checked and unknown: fires on 5 (the finding is the number token, without the sign). 2 has no sign and no unit in the next two tokens ("items", end): skipped.

input.response: A €3 fee applies, or $5 with express shipping, for 2 items.
